name: Qays ibn Zuhayr
bio: Qays ibn Zuhayr, also called Abu Hind, inherited leadership of Abs from his father. He led his people in the war named after the racehorses Dahis and al-Ghabra, and wrote an elegy for Hamal of Fazara, one of the leaders on the other side. His reputation for judgement earned him the name Qays al-Ra’y, and sayings and speeches circulated alongside his verse. Al-Zirikli records that he retired to Oman and lived austerely there until his death in 10 AH (631 CE).
